coverage: Complete completed original plotting entry point

historical_version.input: User-supplied eval_tail prediction file. Original default pointed to tail_reveal_eval_pidif/predictions.parquet and did not identify a checkpoint. Validation explicitly selects central predictions_drop, not a claim about that original default.
historical_version.calculation: Per-bin quantile veto, efficiency(tail)/efficiency(peak), propagated binomial errors. Exact original bias_in_bins function.
historical_version.acceptance: muDIF uses full acceptance>=.5; piDIF uses theta<120 only. E=deposited_energy+dead_E <=75, no lower bound. Require >=10 tail and >=50 peak events in each bin; strict score<threshold.
historical_version.layout: One8×5in axis, muDIF and piDIF ratio curves and error bars, unbiased reference1.0.
historical_version.distinct_from: fig10_mudif_angular.py / angular.py displays suppression, removed signal and original tail fraction in3panels; it does not plot this per-angle-bin bias ratio.

operational_changes: Explicit --pred and --output-dir replace private relative defaults.
Main guard retained; imports do not load data.
Fresh output required and run/input/source record added.
Require populated input and at least one valid curve, otherwise fail rather than write blank plot.
Keep PNG and additionally write PDF and numeric JSON.
bundled_data: No extra input cohorts or generated plots bundled by this export.
